subject: Does RApache need rebuild/install after a new version of R package installation?

messages.author: faa5427c06a1e034
messages.subject: Does RApache need rebuild/install after a new version of R package installation?
parts:
Hi,

Does RApache need rebuild/install if I install a new version of R package?

I had ggplot2 version ggplot2_0.9.1. I was getting an error that 'theme' function not exists. I resolved this by installing recent version of ggplot2 which is ggplot2_0.9.2.1. The R script now works perfect on command line, but when i execute the script with RApache I still get the same error. I am not sure whether I need to recompile/build RApache. Could you please help clarify?

Regards
Santosh

messages.author: 98e634f62928ae87
messages.subject: Re: Does RApache need rebuild/install after a new version of R package installation?
parts:
Hello,

you might have updated ggplot2 as a normal user ending up with a fresh package in your $HOME directory.
Update (and install) the packages as root for global access.

Best,
Gergely
